hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */packages/frontend/src/*.css|*/packages/frontend/src/*.tsx|*/packages/frontend/src/*.ts) d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ -f "$d/scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$d" && node scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs 2>&1) || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":%s}}' "$(printf 'Design-token check after your edit (tokens only, see packages/frontend/src/styles/tokens.css):\n%s' "$out" | head -c 4000 | jq -Rs .)";; esac; }
